paragraphs: (A baraita Tanna.) Hyman mentions him in a dispute with Issi ben Yehudah; Sotah 16a and Sifrei Naso 53.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen parenthetical reads תניא דברייתא; it is read as a baraita-Tanna role label in this notice, not as a separate reported teaching event.

The whole Davidson Sotah 16a paragraphs name Issi ben Menachem and also mention Issi ben Yehudah. The entire returned Wikisource Sifrei Bamidbar 53 paragraph concerns the dedication of the altar and does not name either Issi. This is a bounded nonmatch, not absence elsewhere or equivalence of section numbering. Hyman’s Sifrei Naso 53 locator and the supplied תניא דברייתא role wording remain unchanged.
